description: Compact statistic card showing a primary metric value, label, and optional secondary trend value with configurable color. Since 2.10.0 the card also carries an opt-in KPI surface — a delta with its direction and comparison label, an icon, a sparkline, a loading skeleton, an animated numeric value and a whole-card link or button target — and every one of those parts is off by default, so the card without them renders exactly the markup it always did.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: Card label / metric name.

parameters.name: Label
parameters.description: Alias for Title.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Primary metric value (e.g. "1,234" or "$5,000"). Ignored when NumericValue is set.

parameters.name: SubValue
parameters.description: Secondary value or trend indicator (e.g. "+12% this month").

parameters.name: SubValueColor
parameters.description: Colour for the SubValue, as a CSS colour value — a var(--tm-*) token reference, a hex literal (#16a34a), an rgb/hsl/oklch/color-mix function, or a named colour (seagreen). Rendered as the element's own --tm-stat-subvalue-color custom property, which the base .tm-stat-subvalue rule resolves with var(--tm-stat-subvalue-color, var(--tm-text-secondary)): the parameter therefore ALWAYS wins over the default colour, no matter where the consumer's stylesheet sits in source order. Only meaningful together with SubValue: without it there is nothing to colour and the card REFUSES to render (see OnParametersSet).

parameters.name: Delta
parameters.description: The metric's change over the comparison period in PERCENT POINTS: 12.5 renders as +12,5 % in Czech and +12.5% in English (the symbol and its spacing follow the culture's own percent pattern). Null (the default) renders no delta; the trend marker can still appear through TrendDirection. The value is formatted with DeltaFormat and Culture.

parameters.name: DeltaFormat
parameters.description: An explicit .NET numeric format string for Delta. Null (the default) uses the culture's percent convention; a malformed explicit format falls back to that convention instead of throwing out of a render.

parameters.name: TrendDirection
parameters.description: The direction of the trend. Auto (the default) derives it from the sign of Delta; the explicit members exist for a metric whose delta is unknown but whose direction is not. Without a delta and with Auto no trend marker renders at all.

parameters.name: PositiveIsGood
parameters.description: Whether a rise is the good outcome. It decides the TONE only (the --positive/--negative class), never the direction word or the arrow: a metric where less is better (churn, latency, error rate) passes false and still reads "Decrease".

parameters.name: ComparisonLabel
parameters.description: The comparison the delta is measured against, e.g. "vs. last month". Host data — the component does not localize it — rendered next to the delta; null renders nothing.

parameters.name: Icon
parameters.description: Name of an icon (IconNames constants or a registry entry) rendered in the card's top corner. Decorative by design: the label and value already name the card, so the icon is aria-hidden. Setting it also puts tm-stat-card--has-icon on the root, which reserves the corner gutter on the value and the label (padding-inline-end: calc(2.25rem + var(--tm-space-2))) so a long title or a wide value never runs underneath the absolutely positioned icon. Null renders nothing; a loading card paints no icon and carries no modifier.

parameters.name: Sparkline
parameters.description: Optional sparkline data rendered as a mini chart under the metric (through TmSparkline). Null or empty renders nothing. On a static card the chart keeps its own accessible name from TmSparkline; on an interactive card (Href/OnClick) the wrapper is aria-hidden, because the target's accessible name is built from its content and the chart's role=img label would otherwise be spliced into it.

parameters.name: IsLoading
parameters.description: Renders the card as a loading placeholder: three skeletons in place of the value plus a visually hidden localized "Loading" text, with aria-busy="true" on the root. The label stays visible (it is static information) while the data-bearing parts are not rendered.

parameters.name: AnimateValue
parameters.description: Animates NumericValue through TmAnimatedNumber. False (the default) is a pure-Blazor path with no JavaScript at all; reduced motion is honoured by TmAnimatedNumber independently of this switch.

parameters.name: NumericValue
parameters.description: The metric as a NUMBER, rendered through TmAnimatedNumber with ValueFormat and Culture. When set it wins over the string Value (a card cannot show two values); when null the string value renders as before.

parameters.name: ValueFormat
parameters.description: The .NET numeric format string of NumericValue (default N0 — whole, group-separated numbers), matching TmAnimatedNumber.Format.

parameters.name: ValuePrefix
parameters.description: Text placed before NumericValue (a currency symbol, a sign), forwarded to TmAnimatedNumber.Prefix. Host data — the component does not localize it. Ignored when the string Value supplies the value instead.

parameters.name: ValueSuffix
parameters.description: Text placed after NumericValue (for example " %"), forwarded to TmAnimatedNumber.Suffix. Host data — the component does not localize it. Ignored when the string Value supplies the value instead.

parameters.name: Culture
parameters.description: The culture that formats Delta and NumericValue. Null (the default) means the current culture at render time.

parameters.name: Href
parameters.description: Turns the whole card into a link: the root becomes an <a class="tm-stat-card tm-stat-card--interactive">, one native focus stop with the platform's focus and activation behaviour. Only a relative URL or the http, https and mailto schemes render. The scheme is parsed by the component, not by Uri, because a browser strips ASCII tab/LF/CR before reading the scheme: a value carrying ANY control character is refused outright, and a scheme is the text before the first /, ? or # for a case-insensitive match against the three accepted names. A refused value (javascript:, data:, vbscript:, protocol-relative //elsewhere, java\tscript:) means NO target at all — the card falls back to the plain div rather than a link that lies about being one. OnClick wins when both are set.

parameters.name: OnClick
parameters.description: Turns the whole card into a button: the root becomes a <button type="button" class="tm-stat-card tm-stat-card--interactive"> and this callback fires on click. Native Enter/Space activation applies (the component adds no key handling) and a nested interactive control is not allowed inside it.

parameters.name: DataTestId
parameters.description: Overrides the root data-testid. The default card renders NO data-testid at all (that is part of the byte-identical legacy markup), so the attribute appears only when the host asks for it or sets TestIdPrefix.

parameters.name: TestIdPrefix
parameters.description: Namespaces the card's opt-in internal test ids (stat-card-trend, stat-card-sparkline, stat-card-value, stat-card-icon).

examples.title: Stat card with trend
examples.code:
<TmStatCard Title="Total Revenue"
            Value="$45,231"
            SubValue="+12.5% from last month"
            SubValueColor="var(--tm-color-success-text)" />

examples.title: KPI card: animated value, delta, comparison and sparkline
examples.code:
<TmStatCard Title="Revenue"
            NumericValue="@revenue"
            AnimateValue="true"
            Delta="12.5"
            ComparisonLabel="vs. last month"
            Icon="trending-up"
            Sparkline="@dailyRevenue" />

examples.title: Metric where less is better, as a whole-card link
examples.code:
<TmStatCard Title="Churn"
            NumericValue="2.1"
            ValueFormat="N1"
            ValueSuffix=" %"
            Delta="-3"
            PositiveIsGood="false"
            Href="/reports/churn" />
